narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Triangle eigh O E is congruent to triangle S O Y. The order of letters does not matter.
<bookmark mark='pair'/>His order pairs eigh with S, and E with Y. Those corners do not sit in matching places.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The order of letters tells which corner matches which, so it does matter.
